finding_scope: Cached Brief output did not match the deterministic Monitor import. This is an import fault, not a new AI classification or a completed original-source audit.
root_cause: Legacy policy migration preserved generated copy, then unchanged input hashes bypassed reconstruction. Input fingerprints alone did not validate the published output.
repository_correction: Rebuild every qualified record deterministically; detect noncanonical saved output on every scheduled feed check; verify exact saved/public copy and every ordinary live government article body, date, country, source and headline.
